query: Before the extension, by when were debenture trustees supposed to move their non-SEBI activities into a separate unit?
answer_passage:
may transfer its activities that are not regulated by
SEBI to separate business unit(s) within a period of six months from the date of
notification of the SEBI (Debenture Trustees) (Amendment) Regulations, 2025 in
the Official Gazette
reference_answer: Within six months of the 27 October 2025 notification -- that is, by 27 April 2026. Circular 10421 then granted a further six months, to 27 October 2026.
stale_trap: the same circular's paragraph 3 gives the extended date of October 27, 2026, which is the more prominent number

query: What was the original deadline for merchant bankers to transfer activities to a Separate Business Unit?
answer_passage:

2026
reference_answer: July 03, 2026, under the January 2026 MB Circular. Circular 13567 extended it to December 31, 2026.

query: Of SEBI's 2026 timeline extensions, which gave the most additional time and which the least?
answer_passage:
it has been decided to grant additional six months for compliance
by the DTs. Accordingly, the provisions of the aforesaid amendment and circular
shall be implemented by Debenture Trustees by October 27, 2026. || SEBI has decided to extend the timeline until September 03, 2026, || The circular shall now come
into effect from 7th September 2026.
reference_answer: Most: debenture trustees, six further months to October 27, 2026 (circular 10421). Least: the ETF price band norms, six days from September 1 to September 7, 2026 (19839). PaRRVA enrolment sits between, extended one month to September 03, 2026 (18038).
stale_trap: four extension circulars share almost identical framing, and each states only its own new date
